title: ApplyCapabilitiesPayload
description: The payload of an apply_capabilities job: an ordered list of capability operations applied under ONE project lock, with per-step durability. One job rather than one job per operation because a reconstruction is a single user intent that must hold the lock once, create one recovery point, and report as one reply -- while still recording per-step state so a retry resumes rather than repeats. 'required_scene_version' is the version the plan was reasoned against; the worker verifies it in-lock before the first mutation and refuses with SCENE_VERSION_MISMATCH if the project has moved on. Later steps chain to the version their predecessor produced, so an intentional change does not reject the next step while an external change still does.

operations.description: Operations in execution order. operation_index values must be 0, 1, 2, ... with no gaps.

required_scene_version.description: The authoritative scene version the plan was reasoned against. Absent when the project had never been read, which is the case for the very first modelling request.

summary.description: One-line description of the whole plan, shown in the transcript.
